verdict: Paid ads remain unlaunched; five overdue milestones are being resolved now.

All five overdue milestones are being resolved as the immediate priority so that Google Local Service Ads, Search, and Meta campaigns can launch. Once live, paid channels will give you a trackable lead flow and give us intake data to optimize against.
